body.message:
Hi, I’m planning to move to Dubai and I’m looking for a furnished studio or 1-bedroom apartment to live in.

I would like to rent it monthly, initially for 30 days, with the possibility of extending my stay for several months.

I’m also planning to work in Dubai. Could you please let me know if you offer monthly rental contracts suitable for someone who is moving to Dubai for work, and what documents are required?

My preferred location is within around 20–30 minutes walking distance from Burj Khalifa / Dubai Mall.

My budget is around €1,200 per month.

Thank you!
